parsed.name: 内部系统伪设备
parsed.description: 一种无独立硬件实体的系统状态伪设备，用于把主机操作系统的内部信息或服务抽象为可监测的逻辑输入，例如网络连通性、处理器温度、系统负载、时钟时间段和磁盘占用。在实验自动化中常用于状态监测、条件触发和联动控制。
parsed.description_en: A pseudo-device with no standalone hardware representation, used to expose host operating-system state or services as monitorable logical inputs, such as network reachability, CPU temperature, system load, time-of-day windows, and disk usage. In lab automation, it is commonly used for status monitoring, conditional triggering, and event-driven coordination.
